name: Elwynn Forest
summary: Elwynn Forest is good green country, and Stormwind lives off its timber and gold, its fish and grain. It ought to be a peaceful place. But vermin, stray beasts and brigands roam the woods. So Northshire Abbey sends its recruits out to deal with them.

sections.title: The Breadbasket of the Realm
sections.body: The forest runs south from Stormwind's gates, all the way down to the Nazferiti River. It rains a good deal here, and the fields are the richer for it. Behind the fields grow thick hardwoods, and their timber goes to the capital. Carts roll up from Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp, loaded with grain and livestock, lumber and raw copper. Elwynn breeds horses too, and knights and travelers all over the kingdom are glad to own a sturdy Evendale horse.

sections.title: A Precarious Peace
sections.body:
But these are uneasy days. The Stormwind Army is busy far away, so the marshals and deputies must make do with recruits who have never been tested. Kobolds have overrun the Fargodeep and Jasperlode mines. Riverpaw gnolls prowl the southwestern borders, and murlocs have taken the shores of Stone Cairn Lake and Crystal Lake.

Even the wolves are newcomers. They fled the corruption across the river in Duskwood, and came over into Elwynn.

sections.title: The Red Bandana Threat
sections.body:
The Defias Brotherhood has spread through Elwynn as an organized band of outlaws. Its members came from Edwin VanCleef’s Stonemasons Guild after bitter disputes over pay with the House of Nobles.

They have taken the Northshire Vineyards, the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Jerod’s Landing, and Mirror Lake Orchard. Rumors say their agents are guiding nearby gnolls and kobolds to unsettle the realm. Guards Rolf and Malakai went to investigate murlocs near Stone Cairn Lake; both were killed and left on its banks.

faq.q: Why is the Stormwind Guard barely policing the forest?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s armed forces are stretched thin. The kingdom sent large forces south into Stranglethorn Vale, piling up debt and draining local manpower. Westbrook Garrison and Goldshire now rely on small crews and volunteer recruits to face bandits, gnolls, and murlocs.

faq.q: Why are there kobolds inside all the mines?
aliases: why are kobolds in the mines
faq.answer: Guards are scarce, and kobolds have swarmed into Fargodeep Mine, Jasperlode Mine, and Echo Ridge Mine for gold and minerals. They drove out the human prospectors and miners, then defended their claims with candles, crude picks, and scavenged tools.

faq.q: Who are the bandits wearing red masks?
aliases: who are the defias in elwynn
faq.answer: The red-masked bandits are the Defias Brotherhood, outlaws who have seized farms and mines across Elwynn and Westfall. The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill in Westfall is still trying to learn who leads them and why.

faq.q: Where does the road south lead?
faq.answer: The road south crosses the Nazferiti River into Duskwood. Once peaceful, the territory has fallen into unnatural darkness and is infested with undead, monstrous spiders, and ravenous beasts.

faq.q: What is the feud between the Maclures and Stonefields?
faq.answer: The Stonefields and Maclures are neighboring farming families in southern Elwynn, locked in a bitter, longstanding grudge. Their younger kin, Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield, have secretly fallen in love, making the rivalry more fraught.

faq.q: What is the Tower of Azora?
aliases: tower on the road to eastvale
who lives in the tower of azora
faq.answer: The Tower of Azora is an arcane spire beside the road between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp. Secluded mages live there, including Theocritus, who studies the region’s leylines and conducts magical research beyond the direct oversight of Stormwind’s Wizard’s Sanctum.

angles.text: As a human, you begin in the ancestral heart of the kingdom. You train at Northshire Abbey before setting out to defend your homeland from bandits, beasts, and political ruin.
As a rogue, you find Elwynn crossed by the Defias Brotherhood’s shadow, with thievery, smuggled goods, and underground rebel signals.
As a miner, you find copper veins in Echo Ridge, Fargodeep, and Jasperlode. Kobolds infest these mines, but they remain an important early proving ground.
As an Alliance member, you help protect the Alliance’s primary human kingdom. Stormwind City depends on Elwynn’s lumber, ore, and grain routes.
